perspective:
Bradley Ochoa’s accessible information:

- He is a salesperson at a marketing firm and works with Katherine Lasiloo, the marketing manager. Their professional relationship is cordial but strained by differing opinions on sales and marketing strategies.
- In a meeting room, Bradley has prepared data and charts from the last five campaigns to support traditional sales techniques. He believes those methods are being overlooked in favor of newer digital strategies.
- He tells Katherine he appreciates her digital strategies but argues traditional methods still benefit core sales. He hears Katherine respond that the market is evolving, that digital outreach has potential, and that they should analyze data together to integrate both approaches.
- After the meeting, Bradley hears and sees Katherine share recent digital campaign success stories that boosted engagement and sales. He feels uncertain and questions his earlier support for only traditional methods.
- He asks Katherine to explain how digital strategies are developed. He hears her explain targeting the right audience with the right message and walking through analytics and decision-making.
- Bradley admits his doubts and says he wants to understand digital approaches more. He hears Katherine say she is glad he is open, that adaptation is important, and that they should dive deeper into data.
- Bradley proposes a joint strategy meeting to combine traditional and digital strategies. He hears Katherine agree, suggest combining strengths, and schedule a brainstorm/outline session.
- After the joint meeting, Bradley is excited and works overtime on a board presentation draft integrating both their ideas. He tells Katherine about the draft.
- He hears Katherine praise the draft as comprehensive and well thought out. Bradley says he is convinced the integrated approach will set them apart and wants to nail the presentation.
- He hears Katherine say she is confident and suggest reviewing/fine-tuning. They go through it once more.
- After the presentation and implementation, Bradley feels grateful for his professional growth and the collaboration. He thanks Katherine and says he has learned much from her.
- He hears Katherine say it was a pleasure, the project came to fruition, and his openness made the partnership successful.
- Bradley proposes regular strategy sessions. He hears Katherine agree, saying they will keep on top of their game and market trends.
